paragraphs: R. Yehudah Gelustra, R. Yochanan's student. Berakhot, locator כ״ב הע״א [checked at 22a:24]: when Rav Dimi came, he said R. Akiva and R. Yehudah Gelustra said, etc. I do not know the basis for his being R. Yochanan's student; Sheerit Yosef does not list him among his students.
